title: Paso 9: servicio de simulación Mesa mediante API

response_indicators: wait, door-to-doctor, attention and length-of-stay mean/median/p90/p95

validation.service_integration: tested against Mesa with a synthetic one-hour profile
validation.http_server_smoke_test: passed with Uvicorn; health, version and 24-hour Mesa simulation returned HTTP 200
validation.streamlit_ui: rendered and exercised through AppTest against the live API; supports 1-10 sequential replications, aggregate indicators and JSON download
validation.reproducibility: same request and seed return identical aggregate output; changed seed changes synthetic arrivals
validation.holdout_2018: exploratory 4-window check completed; capacity review required; summary at validation/phase6_validation_summary.json

known_limits: The pretrained ESI LightGBM model is inventoried but not invoked because its 769-feature contract is unavailable from synthetic arrivals.
The API still requires deployment to install the api extra and mount the restricted calibration cache at runtime.
Poisson hourly arrival counts and uniform within-hour placement remain simulation assumptions that need empirical validation.
